objective: Define the minimal safe MCP supervisor loop contract for Codex-managed worker pickup/review/result reporting, without enabling real process launch or touching task statuses.
acceptance: Must specify MCP request/response schema for Codex -> MCP -> worker CLI -> MCP -> Codex flow.
Must include dryrun-only lifecycle states: planned, dispatched_dryrun, worker_review_ready, codex_reviewed, blocked.
Must include safety boundaries: no credential read, no daemon start, no real process launch, no writes unless explicit future gate.
Must include error taxonomy for collision, stale task, runner/topic mismatch, missing artifact, and failed validation.
Must not patch source code in this task.
commit_contract: NO_COMMIT preferred for worker; Codex finalizes explicit allowed_writes only. Never git add -A / git add . / mixed-task commit.
